name: wraith
languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.name: create specter
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets a humanoid within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=vNy9KUqUheOdKL27]] of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.PuPo4H4Dcxigf0fY]{specter} in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

actions.name: life drain
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

actions.name: sunlight sensitivity
actions.desc: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: incorporeal movement
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move through other creatures and objects as if they were &reference[difficult terrain]. It takes [[/damage average]] damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
